name: Erhardt Woodworks
old_description: Erhardt Woodworks specializes in custom cabinets, painted cabinets, MDF doors, epoxy resin tables, and live-edge furniture. Every piece is handcrafted in our Bismarck, North Dakota workshop and tailored to fit your home, business, or remodeling project. Whether you need a single live-edge table or a full kitchen cabinet installation, our team handles the entire process, from design to installation.
about:
Erhardt Woodworks operates a woodworking workshop in Bismarck, North Dakota, serving residential and commercial clients across Burleigh and Morton Counties. The company handcrafts every piece in its Bismarck facility and tailors each project to the client's home, business, or remodeling needs.

The shop produces custom European-style cabinets, painted cabinets, MDF doors and drawer fronts, Baltic birch dovetail drawer boxes, epoxy resin tables, live-edge furniture, and live-edge countertops. Its capabilities cover design, fabrication, finishing, delivery, and installation. Materials include solid hardwoods, MDF, high-quality veneers, Baltic birch, and premium epoxy resin systems formulated to resist yellowing, heat, and moisture. Typical turnaround ranges from four to six weeks for smaller builds such as vanity cabinets, and eight to twelve weeks for full kitchen projects.

Erhardt Woodworks serves homeowners, general contractors, and business owners in Bismarck, Mandan, Lincoln, and surrounding communities, with select work extending across North Dakota. Projects range from single live-edge tables and accent cabinets to complete kitchen renovations and commercial fit-outs.

The company differentiates itself through color- and profile-matching services that replicate existing door styles using MDF or solid wood, a showroom where clients can examine finishes in person, and a commitment to managing each project from initial design through final installation.
